## 2026-11-26

### Anatomical Handling Properties of Costal and Auricular Cartilage in Fresh-frozen Cadaveric Models for Revision Rhinoplasty
- 期刊: Surgical and Radiologic Anatomy
- 第一作者: Russo F
- 单位: Unit of Plastic Surgery, University of Naples "Federico II", Naples, Italy
- PMID: 43062723 | DOI: 10.1007/s00276-026-04039-x
- 事实: 10 具新鲜冷冻尸体头颈加 2 个胸部标本，双侧取第 5–8 肋软骨和耳廓软骨，比较切取、切薄片、缝合的手感。肋软骨硬脆似钙化，切薄片 85% 碎裂，稍厚也见微骨折、缝合时断开；耳软骨保持弹性，能稳定切薄片、缝合不断。
- 点评: 创新点：此前没人系统评估新鲜冷冻尸体能否模拟修复鼻整形的软骨准备。意义：在这种标本上练肋软骨切薄片，手感会练偏；练耳软骨雕刻更可靠，肋软骨只适合练开胸取骨那一段。
- English: Ten fresh-frozen cadaveric heads and two thoracic specimens were dissected, with costal cartilage taken bilaterally from ribs 5-8 and auricular cartilage through a posterior conchal approach, then rated for graft dimensions, preparation time, carvability, laminar fragmentation and suturability. Costal cartilage behaved as rigid, brittle and calcified: laminar thinning fragmented in 85% of attempts, and thicker slices showed microfractures and broke during suturing. Auricular cartilage kept its elasticity, carved into reproducible laminas and held sutures. The study is the first systematic look at whether fresh-frozen cadavers can stand in for the cartilage work of revision rhinoplasty, and the answer is source-specific. Practising thin costal laminas on these specimens teaches the wrong feel, whereas auricular cartilage is a fair model for carving; rib harvest retains value only as thoracic-exposure training.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-26-pmid-43062723

### Perception Meets Precision: Parent-Reported Outcomes of Intermediate Rhinoplasty in Unilateral Cleft Lip
- 期刊: Journal of Craniofacial Surgery
- 第一作者: Bangun K
- 单位: Division of Plastic Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery, Universitas Indonesia - Cipto Mangunkusumo Hospital, Jakarta, Indonesia
- PMID: 43070921 | DOI: 10.1097/scs.0000000000013603
- 事实: 印尼唇腭裂中心 2019–2025 年的中期鼻整形患儿，28 位家长中 20 位完成 Byrne 问卷，随访 1.5 个月至 6 年。90% 满意；鼻尖突度中位分 5 升到 8.5，对称性 5 到 7，通气 8 到 9。
- 点评: 创新点：用经验证的问卷把家长眼中的效果量成可比的分数，随访跨度近 6 年。意义：术前谈话可以把突度、对称性大概能改善多少讲成具体档次，不只说会好看一些；但无对照、年龄跨度大，只能当参考。
- English: Parents of children with unilateral cleft lip and palate who had intermediate rhinoplasty at Indonesia's national cleft centre between 2019 and 2025 were surveyed with the validated Byrne Questionnaire; 20 of 28 eligible parents responded (71.4%), with follow-up from 1.5 months to almost 6 years. Ninety percent reported satisfaction, and median scores rose from 5 to 8.5 for tip projection, 5 to 7 for symmetry, 5 to 7 for appearance and 8 to 9 for breathing. The innovation is quantifying the parent's view with a validated instrument across a follow-up span of nearly six years, albeit in a small single-centre sample. It lets a consultation put expected gains in projection and symmetry into concrete grades instead of vague reassurance, but the absence of a control group and the wide age range keep it at the level of reference data.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-26-pmid-43070921

### Neuropsychiatric Outcomes After Decompressive Craniectomy and Cranioplasty: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis（systematic review）
- 期刊: Neurosurgical Review
- 第一作者: Bari SSM
- 单位: Department of Neurosurgery, Queen's Hospital, Barking, Havering and Redbridge University Hospitals NHS Trust, London, UK
- PMID: 43062567 | DOI: 10.1007/s10143-026-04560-y
- 事实: 系统综述 24 项研究、877 例去骨瓣减压患者，12 项、305 例进 Meta 分析。抑郁患病率 47%（95%CI 40–54%），焦虑 46%（38–54%）；仅 2 项纵向研究报修补后 12 个月焦虑抑郁下降。
- 点评: 创新点：把去骨瓣减压后抑郁焦虑的发生率合并成可比数字，样本量超过多数单中心报告。意义：这类患者随访该常规筛情绪和认知，不只盯骨窗与影像；修补术前谈话也可以提一句心理状态有改善可能。
- English: This systematic review and meta-analysis pooled 24 studies (877 patients) after decompressive craniectomy, with 12 studies (305 patients) entering the meta-analysis. Pooled prevalence was 47% for depression (95% CI 40-54%) and 46% for anxiety (38-54%); only two longitudinal studies reported falls in both at 12 months after cranioplasty, and the authors caution that those large effect sizes may be inflated by small cohorts. The innovation is turning scattered single-centre reports into pooled prevalence figures for psychiatric morbidity after decompressive craniectomy. The practical consequence is that these patients need routine mood and cognitive screening alongside bone-window and imaging follow-up, and that pre-cranioplasty counselling can mention a likely psychological gain without promising it.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-26-pmid-43062567

## 2026-11-25

### Septum-Anchored Teostrut With Diced Costal Cartilage for Definitive Asian Cleft Rhinoplasty
- 期刊: Journal of Craniofacial Surgery
- 第一作者: Bangun K
- 单位: Cleft and Craniofacial Center, Cipto Mangunkusumo General Hospital, Jakarta
- PMID: 43070927 | DOI: 10.1097/scs.0000000000013617
- 事实: 回顾性 16 例亚洲唇腭裂修复后患者，做定型期鼻整形：鼻尖用锚定在鼻中隔的单柱移植物（Teostrut）支撑，鼻背用切碎肋软骨铺垫。术后照片测量鼻背偏斜改善 0.9°，鼻翼角不对称改善约 11–13°，69% 患者自报鼻通气好转，无重大并发症。
- 点评: 创新点：把鼻中隔锚定的单柱移植物和切碎肋软骨合用于亚洲唇裂鼻，16 例且有客观照片测量。意义：唇裂鼻二次修复可拿碎软骨垫鼻背、避开整块移植的僵硬；但无对照组、随访期没报，只算初步可行。
- English: This retrospective series reports 16 Asian patients with repaired cleft lip and palate who underwent definitive rhinoplasty using a septum-anchored monopod graft (Teostrut) for tip support plus diced costal cartilage for dorsal augmentation. Photographic analysis showed 0.9 degrees of improvement in dorsum deviation and roughly 11 to 13 degrees of correction in alar angle asymmetry; 69% of patients reported functional improvement and there were no major complications. The innovation is pairing a septum-anchored monopod strut with diced costal cartilage in the Asian cleft nose, with objective photographic measurement in 16 cases. It offers a reproducible way to support the tip and camouflage the dorsum in secondary cleft deformity, but the series has no control group and does not report follow-up length, so it remains preliminary.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-25-pmid-43070927

### Multimodal AI for Rhinoplasty Consultation and Simulation: A Blinded Expert Evaluation
- 期刊: Facial Plastic Surgery
- 第一作者: Hack S
- 单位: Sheba Medical Center, University of Nicosia, City St. George's University London School of Medicine, Program Delivered by University of Nicosia at the Chaim Sheba Medical Center, Tel Aviv District, Israel, Tel HaShomer
- PMID: 43063989 | DOI: 10.1055/a-3003-2319
- 事实: 让 GPT-5.5 用 20 例鼻整形患者术前照片生成咨询话术和术后模拟图，4 名双盲面整形外科医生按 12 项五分制打分。语言清晰度最高 4.05 分，手术方案适当性 2.90、避免不必要手术 2.59、方案与模拟图一致性 2.33 最低；医生完全认可方案仅 7.6%。
- 点评: 创新点：首次用双盲专家评分检验多模态模型在真实鼻整形病例上的咨询与模拟输出，而非演示。意义：模拟图好看不等于方案对，门诊可拿它当沟通辅助，不能让患者照图定手术；适应证、该不该做仍要医生逐条复核。
- English: Preoperative photographs from 20 rhinoplasty patients were given to GPT-5.5, which generated consultation text and simulated postoperative images; four blinded fellowship-trained facial plastic surgeons rated each output on 12 five-point items plus utility and plan-agreement questions. Language clarity scored highest at 4.05 of 5, whereas procedure appropriateness (2.90), avoidance of inappropriate procedures (2.59) and plan-to-simulation fidelity (2.33) were weakest. Surgeons fully agreed with the proposed plan in only 7.6% of assessments. The innovation is a blinded, case-level validity test of multimodal AI on real rhinoplasty consultations rather than a demonstration. The findings support supervised adjunctive use only: wording reads well and simulations look plausible, but patient-specific surgical validity is inconsistent, so an image should never be treated as a surgical promise.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-25-pmid-43063989

### Intraoperative Mapping of the Zygomaticofacial Nerve: Implications for Safe Dissection in Endoscopic Facelift Surgery
- 期刊: Aesthetic Surgery Journal
- 第一作者: Askeroglu U
- 单位: Dr Askeroglu is a plastic surgeon
- PMID: 43071833 | DOI: 10.1093/asj/sjag264
- 事实: 前瞻性研究在 158 例内窥镜拉皮术中，用 30° 内镜双侧辨认颧面神经（zygomaticofacial nerve，ZFN）出孔与分支。单支右侧 82%、左侧 87%，双孔 13% 与 8%，三孔≤2%，双侧缺如 4%；颧面孔距眶下缘约 5.5 mm、距颧弓约 10 mm，左右对称。
- 点评: 创新点：颧面神经数据此前多来自尸体，这是 158 例活体术中实测，同类里样本最大。意义：颧区剥离时按距眶下缘 5.5 mm、距颧弓 10 mm 找神经出孔位置，可少伤分支、减少术后颊部麻木；但只测出孔，未随访感觉功能。
- English: In a prospective intraoperative study of 158 patients undergoing endoscopic facelift, the zygomaticofacial nerve (ZFN) and its foramina were mapped bilaterally under 30-degree endoscopic magnification. A single branch was present in 82% of right and 87% of left sides, double foramina in 13% and 8%, triple foramina in 2% or fewer, and bilateral absence in 4%; mean nerve count was slightly higher on the right (1.13 plus or minus 0.48 versus 1.04 plus or minus 0.38). The foramen averaged about 5.5 mm from the infraorbital rim and 10 mm from the zygomatic arch, with strong bilateral symmetry. The innovation is living-tissue measurement in 158 patients, the largest series of its kind, where earlier ZFN data came almost entirely from cadavers. Those two distances give a practical landmark for dissection in the zygomatic region, although the study mapped foramina only and did not follow postoperative sensation.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-25-pmid-43071833

## 2026-11-24

### Pilot Study: Preliminary Experience with Dual-strut Tip Support Using Repurposed Cephalic Trim Cartilage in East Asian Rhinoplasty
- 期刊: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery – Global Open
- 第一作者: Morello AM
- 单位: MSA Surgical Arts, Naha, Okinawa, Japan
- PMID: 43032422 | DOI: 10.1097/gox.0000000000008156
- 事实: 回顾性 10 例东亚初次鼻整形（日本女性，平均 33.7 岁），用梯形鼻中隔延伸移植物加双侧鼻小柱支撑杆，支撑杆取自已切除的鼻翼软骨头侧缘；随访 10.1 个月，无感染、移植物外露、鼻中隔不稳或鼻尖变形。
- 点评: 创新点：把本该丢弃的头侧缘软骨改造成双支撑杆，不额外取耳或肋软骨就强化鼻尖三脚架。意义：鼻中隔软骨不足、只需中等鼻尖支撑的东亚鼻可少开一处供区；但仅 10 例、无客观测量，属初步可行。
- English: In a retrospective pilot, 10 Japanese women (mean age 33.7 years) underwent primary East Asian rhinoplasty with a trapezoidal septal extension graft plus paired columellar struts fashioned from cephalic-trim cartilage that would otherwise be discarded. The struts were fixed to the distal graft and native medial crura; over a mean 10.1 months (range 7–14) there were no infections, graft extrusions, septal instability, significant tip deformity, external nasal valve compromise or columellar widening. The innovation is reusing excised cephalic cartilage as paired struts, reinforcing the native tripod without a second donor site. It may suit moderate tip repositioning when septal cartilage is limited, but with 10 patients, no objective outcomes and no comparison group, the biomechanical benefit remains theoretical.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-24-pmid-43032422

### Cephalad Migration of Permanent Thread Fragments Following Nose Augmentation by Thread
- 期刊: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery – Global Open
- 第一作者: Yun CW
- 单位: View Aesthetic Plastic Surgery Clinic, Seoul, Republic of Korea
- PMID: 43012028 | DOI: 10.1097/gox.0000000000008126
- 事实: 1 例 54 岁女性，鼻部线雕隆鼻 5 年后额部不平、眉间硬块；手术取出 8 段移位线（2 蓝 6 透明），nuclear magnetic resonance（核磁共振，NMR）证实为聚丙烯-聚乳酸共聚物。
- 点评: 创新点：把多年后的线头移位追到具体共聚物材料与皱眉肌、额肌反复收缩的力学，而非笼统异物反应。意义：问诊要追问线材成分和植入年限，眉间、额部不明硬结先想到线头上移，取出按深部异物设计。
- English: A 54-year-old woman presented five years after thread-based nasal augmentation with forehead irregularity and a firm glabellar mass; exploration retrieved eight migrated thread fragments (two blue, six transparent) along the glabella and forehead. Nuclear magnetic resonance identified the material as a polypropylene–polylactic acid copolymer, and repeated procerus and frontalis contraction with unidirectional barbs was thought to drive cephalad migration. The value is tracing a late thread complication to a specific copolymer and to muscle mechanics rather than a generic foreign-body reaction. Ask patients about thread composition and implant age, and treat unexplained glabellar or forehead nodules after nasal threading as possible migrated threads; retrieval needs a deep-foreign-body approach.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-24-pmid-43012028

### Mailbox Flap Mastopexy: Structural Internal Support Technique to Enhance Lower Pole Stability Breast Ptosis Correction
- 期刊: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery – Global Open
- 第一作者: Centeno-Silva J
- 单位: Sensabell, Madrid–Valencia, Spain
- PMID: 43066456 | DOI: 10.1097/gox.0000000000008237
- 事实: 84 例假体隆胸同期乳房上提（2021–2024），平均 39.7 岁，60.7% 为二次上提；4×4 厘米皮腺瓣锚定胸大肌，90.5% 完全矫正下垂，并发症 23.8%，BREAST-Q 从 35.2 升至 93.8 分。
- 点评: 创新点：用一块 4×4 厘米去上皮皮腺瓣锚到胸大肌做内支撑，把下极稳定从皮肤受力改成结构受力。意义：假体隆胸合并中度下垂、尤其二次上提可少依赖皮肤张力；但并发症 23.8%、无对照，满意度和随访期要如实讲。
- English: In a retrospective cohort of 84 patients having mastopexy with implants between 2021 and 2024 (mean age 39.7 years, mean BMI 23.7), 60.7% were secondary lifts and most had Regnault grade 2 (65.5%) or 3 (31.0%) ptosis. A 4 × 4 cm dermoglandular flap was anchored to the pectoralis with limited subpectoral myotomy; complete ptosis correction was achieved in 90.5%, complications occurred in 23.8% (mainly minor wound dehiscence 5.9%, hypertrophic scar 3.6%, asymmetry 3.6%), and BREAST-Q scores rose from 35.2 to 93.8 (P < 0.001). The innovation is a dermoglandular flap fixed to the pectoralis to support the lower pole structurally instead of relying on skin. It is a reasonable option for moderate ptosis with implants, especially secondary lifts, but the 23.8% complication rate and lack of a control group mean the satisfaction gain and follow-up must be presented honestly.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-24-pmid-43066456

## 2026-11-23

### Anatomical Handling Properties of Costal and Auricular Cartilage in Fresh-frozen Cadaveric Models for Revision Rhinoplasty
- 期刊: Surgical and Radiologic Anatomy
- 第一作者: Russo F
- 单位: Unit of Plastic Surgery, University of Naples "Federico II", Naples, Italy
- PMID: 43062723 | DOI: 10.1007/s00276-026-04039-x
- 事实: 10 具新鲜冷冻尸头加 2 具胸段标本，双侧取第 5–8 肋软骨与耳甲软骨，记录切取、雕刻、缝合表现。肋软骨层状削薄 85% 碎裂，无一块能做成撑开或鼻中隔延伸移植；耳软骨保持弹性，可反复雕刻并承受缝合。
- 点评: 创新点：首次系统检验新鲜冷冻标本能否模拟肋软骨移植制备，而不是默认尸头都能练。意义：尸头课上肋软骨只练切取和胸廓入路，雕刻改用耳软骨或更新鲜标本，别让学员在钙化肋上反复失败。
- English: Ten fresh-frozen cadaveric heads and two thoracic specimens were dissected, harvesting costal cartilage bilaterally from ribs 5–8 and auricular cartilage through a posterior conchal approach, with graft size, preparation time, carvability, laminar fragmentation and suturability recorded. Laminar thinning fragmented costal cartilage in 85% of attempts, thicker slices showed microfractures and broke during suturing, and no costal graft was suitable for spreader or septal extension graft simulation, whereas auricular cartilage stayed elastic, carved reproducibly and held sutures. The study is the first systematic test of whether fresh-frozen cadavers can simulate costal graft preparation, instead of assuming any cadaver head will do. In dissection training the ribs remain useful for harvest and thoracic exposure, but carving practice should use auricular cartilage or fresher tissue, so trainees are not set up to fail on calcified rib.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-23-pmid-43062723

### The Sail-Shaped Modification for Reconstruction of Distal Nasal Defects
- 期刊: Dermatologic Surgery
- 第一作者: Hunter ER
- 单位: Department of Dermatology, Hospital of the University of Pennsylvania, Philadelphia, PA, USA
- PMID: 43049350 | DOI: 10.1097/dss.0000000000005456
- 事实: 30 例 Mohs micrographic surgery（莫氏显微手术，MMS）后鼻远端缺损，用改良帆形鼻背旋转推进皮瓣单期修复；缺损 0.4–3.1 平方厘米（均值 0.96），随访均 9 个月，无并发症、无二次修整。
- 点评: 创新点：皮瓣起点往远端移、回切加长，皮瓣活动度变大而瘢痕走向不变。意义：鼻尖、鼻翼旁小到中等缺损可单期关闭，不必动鼻唇沟皮瓣；延长回切沿鼻侧阴影线走，瘢痕更隐蔽。
- English: Thirty consecutive patients underwent single-stage reconstruction of caudal nasal defects after Mohs micrographic surgery (MMS) with a sail-shaped modification of the dorsal nasal rotation-advancement flap, placing the takeoff point more distally and extending the back cut to gain mobility while keeping scar orientation favourable; defect area was 0.4–3.1 cm² (mean 0.96). At a mean follow-up of 9 months there were no postoperative complications and no revisions. The modification gains flap mobility without changing the direction of the scar, letting small to medium defects of the nasal tip and ala close in one stage rather than pulling in a nasolabial flap. The extended back cut is hidden along the nasal sidewall shadow line, a design detail worth copying when planning the incision.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-23-pmid-43049350

### Platelet-Rich Plasma Does Not Enhance Demineralized Bone Matrix Repair of Critical-Size Calvarial Defects: A 24-Week Study
- 期刊: Journal of Craniofacial Surgery
- 第一作者: Alioğlu C
- 单位: Department of Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery, Kartal Lütfi Kırdar City Hospital, University of Health Sciences, Istanbul, Turkey
- PMID: 43059485 | DOI: 10.1097/scs.0000000000013598
- 事实: 32 只鼠 8 mm 颅骨缺损分四组：空白、platelet-rich plasma（富血小板血浆，PRP）、demineralized bone matrix（脱钙骨基质，DBM）、合用，24 周。DBM 单用优于合用，PRP 同空白。
- 点评: 创新点：随访拉到 24 周并设单用植骨对照，推翻 8–12 周研究里加 PRP 更好的印象。意义：颅面骨移植不必默认掺 PRP，掺了可能延迟闭合；读这类文章先看随访是否超过 12 周。
- English: In a randomised four-arm study, 8 mm critical-size calvarial defects in 32 rats were left untreated or filled with platelet-rich plasma (PRP), demineralized bone matrix (DBM), or both, eight animals per group, and followed by computed tomography to 24 weeks with histological grading. Both matrix groups closed faster than untreated and PRP-only defects, but diverged from week 12: by 24 weeks every matrix-alone animal had closed more than every animal given the combination, and PRP alone never differed from untreated. Its contribution is a 24-week horizon with a graft-alone arm, which undercuts the 8–12 week studies that made adding PRP look beneficial. Adding PRP to DBM produced no extra bone and may delay closure, so cranial grafting should not add PRP by default, and combination studies should be read with their follow-up length in mind.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-23-pmid-43059485

## 2026-11-22

### Multimodal AI for Rhinoplasty Consultation and Simulation: A Blinded Expert Evaluation
- 期刊: Facial Plastic Surgery
- 第一作者: Hack S
- 单位: Sheba Medical Center, University of Nicosia, City St. George's University London School of Medicine, Program Delivered by University of Nicosia at the Chaim Sheba Medical Center, Tel Aviv District, Israel, Tel HaShomer
- PMID: 43063989 | DOI: 10.1055/a-3003-2319
- 事实: 20 例鼻整形患者照片，多模态人工智能生成咨询与术后模拟图；4 名盲法面整形医生按 12 项五分制评分。语言清晰度 4.05 分最高，术式适当性 2.90、方案与模拟一致性 2.33 分垫底；完全认可方案仅 7.6%。
- 点评: 创新点：首次让盲法专家按患者逐个打分多模态人工智能的咨询文本与模拟图，而非只看图像是否逼真。意义：模拟图可作沟通工具，不能当术前承诺；方案必须由医生独立制定，接诊时先问患者是否拿人工智能图来对标。
- English: Preoperative photographs from 20 rhinoplasty patients were used by a multimodal AI (GPT-5.5) to generate a consultation in a standardised patient-voiced prompt and a simulated postoperative image; four blinded fellowship-trained facial plastic surgeons rated each output on 12 five-point items, two utility items and one surgical-plan agreement item, with mixed models using crossed random effects for case and evaluator. Language clarity scored highest at 4.05/5, whereas procedure appropriateness (2.90), avoidance of inappropriate procedures (2.59) and plan-to-simulation fidelity (2.33) were lowest, and full agreement with the surgical plan occurred in only 7.6% of assessments. Its contribution is a blinded, per-patient item-by-item evaluation of both AI text and AI imagery rather than a judgement of how convincing the pictures look. Simulations can support conversation but cannot serve as a preoperative promise; the operative plan must remain the surgeon's, and clinics should ask at consultation whether the patient is benchmarking against an AI-generated image.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-22-pmid-43063989

### Patient-Reported Functional and Cosmetic Outcomes after Rhinoplasty with Autologous Versus Cadaveric Rib Cartilage Grafts
- 期刊: Facial Plastic Surgery & Aesthetic Medicine
- 第一作者: Du DK
- 单位: Washington University School of Medicine in St. Louis, St. Louis, Missouri, USA
- PMID: 43035971 | DOI: 10.1177/26893614261499033
- 事实: 129 例鼻整形队列，33 例自体、96 例异体肋软骨，95.3% 作撑开移植物。调整模型示自体组鼻塞更低（差值 −14.02，95%CI −24.19 至 −3.85），外观相近；翻修率 15.2% 对 24.0%。
- 点评: 创新点：把自体与异体肋软骨放进同一纵向患者报告结局模型，129 例是目前该问题较大的对比样本。意义：功能诉求强的患者可优先考虑自体肋软骨；翻修率差 8.8 个百分点但置信区间跨零，交代时只能说是趋势，不能承诺更低。
- English: This retrospective cohort followed 129 adults undergoing rhinoplasty between 2018 and 2025, 33 with autologous and 96 with cadaveric rib cartilage, used mainly as spreader grafts (95.3%). Adjusted mixed-effects models showed lower mean obstruction scores across follow-up in autologous recipients (difference -14.02; 95% CI -24.19 to -3.85) with similar cosmetic scores (-7.05; 95% CI -16.33 to 2.22), and revisions occurred in 15.2% versus 24.0%. It places autologous and cadaveric rib grafts in one longitudinal patient-reported outcome model, and 129 patients is a comparatively large sample for this question. Where breathing is the priority, autologous rib has the functional edge; the 8.8-point revision gap has a confidence interval crossing zero, so consent should present it as a trend rather than a promise.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-22-pmid-43035971

### Neuropsychiatric outcomes after decompressive craniectomy and cranioplasty: a systematic review and meta-analysis (systematic review)
- 期刊: Neurosurgical Review
- 第一作者: Bari SSM
- 单位: Department of Neurosurgery, Queen's Hospital, Barking, Havering and Redbridge University Hospitals NHS Trust, London, UK
- PMID: 43062567 | DOI: 10.1007/s10143-026-04560-y
- 事实: 24 项研究、877 例去骨瓣减压患者的系统综述与 meta 分析，12 项、305 例入池：抑郁合并患病率 47%（95%CI 40–54%），焦虑 46%；两项纵向研究示颅骨修补后情绪改善，但样本小。
- 点评: 创新点：首次把去骨瓣减压后的抑郁与焦虑做成合并患病率，量化到接近一半。意义：颅骨修补不能只谈外形与脑保护，术前应常规筛情绪，把修补前后当作心理随访节点；文中效应量不宜直接引用，纵向证据仍薄。
- English: This systematic review and meta-analysis pooled 24 studies (N=877) of patients after decompressive craniectomy, with 12 studies (N=305) in the quantitative synthesis. Pooled prevalence was 47% for depression (95% CI 40-54%) and 46% for anxiety (95% CI 38-54%); two longitudinal studies suggested reduced anxiety and depression 12 months after cranioplasty, although small cohorts may have inflated those effect sizes. Its contribution is the first pooled estimate of post-decompressive-craniectomy depression and anxiety, putting the burden near one in two patients. Cranioplasty should therefore be framed as more than contour and brain protection: screen mood before surgery and treat the repair as a psychological follow-up checkpoint, while citing the longitudinal effect sizes cautiously.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-22-pmid-43062567

## 2026-11-21

### Determining the Appropriate Age for Aesthetic Procedures in Minors: A Review of the Guidelines, Outcomes, and Ethical Considerations
- 期刊: Aesthetic Surgery Journal
- 第一作者: Gimenez Lynch C
- 单位: Herbert Wertheim College of Medicine, Florida International University, Miami, FL, USA
- PMID: 43053604 | DOI: 10.1093/asj/sjag265
- 事实: 系统综述青少年医美指南与实践：覆盖注射、激光、皮肤护理，以及耳整形、鼻整形、缩乳、隆胸等手术；各国最低年龄推荐差异很大，多数项目没有统一门槛；纳入研究普遍报告筛选合适者安全性好、满意度高。
- 点评: 创新点：把指南、结局与伦理放进同一篇比较，明确“多数手术没有标准年龄”是现状而非疏漏。意义：接诊未成年人时，别把家长签字当合格线，要单独评估心理成熟度、动机与对风险的理解，把“能做”和“该做”分开说。
- English: This review synthesises regulatory guidance, safety outcomes and ethical principles for aesthetic procedures in minors, covering injectables, lasers and skin care as well as otoplasty, rhinoplasty, breast reduction and breast augmentation. Minimum age recommendations vary widely between countries and procedures, and most operations have no standard age threshold. Included studies generally report favourable safety, high satisfaction and psychosocial improvement in appropriately selected adolescents. Its contribution is putting guidelines, outcomes and ethics side by side, making clear that the absence of a standard age is the current state rather than an oversight. For adolescent rhinoplasty, parental consent is a legal floor, not a fitness test; maturity, motivation and comprehension of risk should decide, and 'can be done' must be separated from 'should be done'.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-21-pmid-43053604

### Does Previous Septoplasty Affect Rhinoplasty Outcomes? A Comparative Analysis of Functional, Psychological and Self-Assessment Measures
- 期刊: Journal of Clinical Medicine
- 第一作者: Jadczak M
- 单位: Department of Otolaryngology with Division of Cranio-Maxillo-Facial Surgery, Military Institute of Medicine-National Research Institute, 04-141 Warsaw, Poland
- PMID: 42941334 | DOI: 10.3390/jcm15207819
- 事实: 75 例鼻中隔鼻整形前瞻队列，27 例（36%）既往有鼻中隔手术、48 例初诊；术后 1、6 个月测 ROE、SCHNOS、NOSE。既往手术组 1 个月总体满意度更低、1 与 6 个月外观评分更差；两组鼻塞均改善。
- 点评: 创新点：把“做过鼻中隔还能不能做鼻整形”从经验判断变成带量表的前瞻对比，且把外观与功能分开看。意义：二次鼻中隔患者术前要单独交代外观恢复更慢、早期满意度偏低，但不因此劝退；无未手术对照组，只能算术前术后变化。
- English: In a prospective cohort of 75 rhinoseptoplasty patients, 27 (36%) had prior septoplasty and 48 were primary cases; ROE, SCHNOS and NOSE were measured before surgery and at 1 and 6 months, with quality of life and self-esteem also assessed. Prior septoplasty was associated with lower overall satisfaction at 1 month and worse cosmetic scores at 1 and 6 months, while nasal obstruction, quality of life and self-esteem improved in both groups. It turns 'can you operate after a previous septoplasty' into a measured prospective comparison and separates appearance from function. For these patients, consent should state slower cosmetic recovery and lower early satisfaction without discouraging surgery; with no unoperated control group, the changes are observed pre- to postoperative differences rather than proof of causation.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-21-pmid-42941334

### Impact of Implant Surface Texture on Complication Rates in Primary Breast Augmentation: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- 第一作者: Neves C
- 单位: Faculty of Medicine, University of Porto, Al. Prof. Hernâni Monteiro, 4200-319, Porto, Portugal. carolinabrandaoneves@gmail.com
- PMID: 43049881 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06428-4
- 事实: 12 项研究、17,726 例初次隆胸的 meta 分析：毛面假体下移更少（RR 0.10，95%CI 0.03–0.33），包膜挛缩、感染、血清肿、再手术无差异；胸肌下放置感染率更低；期内无 BIA-ALCL 病例。
- 点评: 创新点：把“毛面防下移、光面更安全”两边说法放到近 1.8 万例里对齐，毛面只在机械稳定上赢，其余并发症没差别。意义：选假体按解剖条件与放置层次定，腺体前放置要把感染风险讲清；零例 ALCL 只是随访期短，不能当免责。
- English: Twelve studies covering 17,726 primary augmentations were pooled. Textured implants significantly reduced bottoming-out (RR 0.10; 95% CI 0.03-0.33), while capsular contracture, infection, seroma and reoperation showed no significant difference; subpectoral placement had lower infection than prepectoral, and no BIA-ALCL case occurred during follow-up. It lines up both camps' claims across nearly 18,000 patients: texture wins only on mechanical stability, with no difference in other complications. Implant choice should follow anatomy and plane rather than market fashion, prepectoral placement needs an explicit infection discussion, and zero ALCL cases reflect short follow-up, not absolution.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-21-pmid-43049881

## 2026-11-20

### Detecting Manipulated Online Rhinoplasty Images Using an Artificial Intelligence Facial Authenticity Localization (FAL) Model
- 期刊: Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery
- 第一作者: Olabiran A
- 单位: Norwich Medical School, University of East Anglia, Norfolk, UK
- PMID: 42765934 | DOI: 10.1097/prs.0000000000013464
- 事实: 抓取 RealSelf 公开图库连续 600 张鼻整形术后照，用 FAL 模型检测像素级真伪：19.5%（117/600）存在几何篡改。200 张原始临床照假阳性 1.5%，50 张 Facetune 变形照全部检出，敏感度 100%。
- 点评: 创新点：AI 真伪检测首次在整形外科图片上大规模跑，把“照片修过”从印象变成 19.5% 这个可核的数。意义：面诊时患者拿来当模板的参考图，可以先过一遍检测，再谈能不能做。
- English: The Facial Authenticity Localization model was applied to the first 600 consecutive postoperative rhinoplasty photos in RealSelf's public gallery, flagging geometric manipulation in 19.5% (117/600; 95% CI 16.3-22.7%). Specificity testing on 200 presumed-unedited clinical photos gave a 1.5% false-positive rate, and all 50 Facetune-warped images were detected (sensitivity 100%). This is the first large-scale authenticity audit of aesthetic-surgery media, converting 'that photo is edited' into a measurable 19.5%. It offers a defensible pre-consultation check on the reference images patients bring, though validation covered only Facetune-style warps.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-20-pmid-42765934

### Nasal Airflow Changes in Dorsal Preservation Rhinoplasty: A Computational Fluid Dynamics Analysis in Human Anatomic Specimens
- 期刊: Facial Plastic Surgery & Aesthetic Medicine
- 第一作者: Miller JR
- 单位: Department of Otolaryngology-Head & Neck Surgery, Ochsner Health System, New Orleans, Louisiana, USA
- PMID: 42806791 | DOI: 10.1177/26893614261492482
- 事实: 4 具新鲜人体解剖标本，锥形束 CT 建模后做计算流体力学模拟，比较鼻中隔成形与保鼻背鼻整形的气流：除 1 例外，术后鼻阻力均下降，变化方向随上外侧软骨在内鼻阀顶端的朝向而不同。
- 点评: 创新点：保鼻背对通气的影响，此前只有小样本量表和鼻阻力计、结论互相打架；这篇首次在真实解剖标本上用流体力学算出阻力变化。意义：不必预设保鼻背会堵，但差异取决于上外侧软骨朝向。
- English: Computational fluid dynamics was run on cone-beam CT models of four fresh human anatomic specimens before and after septoplasty and dorsal preservation rhinoplasty. Nasal resistance decreased in every specimen but one, and the direction of change tracked the orientation of the upper lateral cartilage at the apical internal nasal valve. Earlier evidence on preservation and airflow came from small rhinomanometry and questionnaire samples that disagreed; this is the first CFD quantification in real anatomic specimens. It argues against assuming preservation stiffens the airway, but four specimens establish direction, not a magnitude to quote in consent.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-20-pmid-42806791

### Deep Plane Facelifts: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Outcomes
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- 第一作者: Koroma P
- 单位: Department of Otolaryngology, Mid Yorkshire Teaching Hospital Trust, Aberford Road, Wakefield, WF1 4DG, United Kingdom
- PMID: 42576065 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06138-x
- 事实: 45 项研究、10,784 例深层平面拉皮的系统综述与 meta 分析：总体并发症 6.6%，无永久性面神经损伤，暂时性面神经损伤 1.2%、血肿 1.8%、血清肿 1.7%、感染 0.8%、增生性瘢痕 2.8%、皮肤坏死 0.1%。
- 点评: 创新点：把“深层平面容易伤面神经”这个流传几十年的顾虑，用一万例合并率压到零例永久损伤。意义：面诊不必再拿神经风险劝人改做 SMAS，该谈的是血肿 1.8%、瘢痕 2.8%；外观更优仍是主观评价。
- English: A PRISMA systematic review and meta-analysis pooled 45 studies and 10,784 deep plane facelifts: overall complications were 6.6%, with no permanent facial nerve injury and temporary nerve injury at 1.2%. Haematoma occurred in 1.8%, seroma 1.7%, infection 0.8%, hypertrophic scarring 2.8% and skin necrosis 0.1%. It retires the decades-old fear that deep plane dissection costs facial nerve function, with zero permanent injuries across more than ten thousand cases. Consent can shift to haematoma 1.8% and scarring 2.8%; the claimed aesthetic superiority over SMAS remains a subjective judgement.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-20-pmid-42576065

### High vs Low Septal Preservation Rhinoplasty: A Quantitative Morphologic Analysis of Hump-Supratip Dynamics
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- 第一作者: Ekici RF
- 单位: Department of Plastic, Reconstructive and Aesthetic Surgery, Karaman Training and Research Hospital, Üniversite Mahallesi, 1984 Street No:1, 70200, Karaman, Turkey
- PMID: 42809129 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06288-y
- 事实: 30例保留鼻整形照片测量：高鼻中隔组鼻尖上区下降更多，低鼻中隔组相对更高。
- 点评: 样本30、非随机、随访短；能说两种做法鼻尖上区反应不同，不能说哪个更好。
- English: In 30 preservation rhinoplasties measured on standardized photographs, the high septal technique lowered the supratip more while the low septal approach left it relatively higher. - Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-18-pmid-42809129

### Capsulectomy Following Breast Implant Removal: Evidence-Based Indications and a Framework for Clinical Decision-Making
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- 第一作者: MChir TB
- 单位: Specialist Plastic Surgeon, Suite 2, 40 Clyde Road, Berwick, VIC, 3806, Australia
- PMID: 42881298 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06365-2
- 事实: 综述：无研究直接比较切除与保留包膜；9590例预注册队列未见BII症状差异，切除并发症更高。
- 点评: 包膜切除只有四个指征：确诊ALCL、包膜恶变、有症状钙化影响钼靶、III–IV级挛缩。其余别当常规。
- English: This review finds no study directly comparing explantation with and without capsulectomy; the only pre-registered controlled cohort (n=9590) showed no difference in BII symptom prevalence, and capsulectomy carries more complications. ### Interval to Secondary Facelift: A Match-Cohort Analysis of Interval Time, Technique, and Complications
- 期刊: Aesthetic Surgery Journal
- 第一作者: Mandelbaum M
- 单位: 
- PMID: 42741888 | DOI: 10.1093/asj/sjag161
- 事实: 97对97配对：二次拉皮比初次短44.3分钟、更多用SMAS折叠，并发症无差异；间隔平均10.7年。

- PMID: 42897248 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06374-1
- 事实: 72例深层除皱，5个AI模型估龄降7.64岁（15.7%），与FACE-Q弱相关（ρ 0.25）。
- 点评: AI估龄可当客观指标，但病人自评年轻多少才是主结局；两者的数别混着报。
- English: In 72 deep-plane face and neck lifts, five CNN models estimated a mean age reduction of 7.64 years (15.7%), but AI estimates correlated only weakly with FACE-Q scores (rho 0.25). AI age estimation is reproducible as an objective metric, yet patient-perceived rejuvenation correlated far more strongly (rho 0.61) and should stay the primary outcome.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-14-pmid-42897248

### The Distal U-Shaped Capsule Sparing Technique (DUS-CS) for Revision Breast Augmentation: A Consecutive Clinical Series of 223 Patients
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- 第一作者: Bromba AM
- 单位: Department of Plastic and Aesthetic Surgery, Interdisciplinary Breast Center, Sana Kliniken Düsseldorf GmbH, Gräulinger Straße 120, 40625, Düsseldorf, Germany
- PMID: 42881301 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06351-8
- 事实: 223例包膜挛缩翻修用U形保留包膜技术，现有随访内无复发、无双乳相通、无下移。
- 点评: 留部分包膜能稳住腔隙、少创伤；但这是单中心描述性研究，随访时长没写，别当治愈率。
- English: In 223 consecutive revision augmentations, a U-shaped selective capsulectomy sparing medial, lateral and caudal capsule produced no recurrence of contracture, symmastia or bottoming out during available follow-up. Capsule-sparing revision preserves pocket geometry with less morbidity, but this single-center descriptive series does not report follow-up duration and cannot establish a recurrence rate.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-14-pmid-42881301

### A Modified Pre-implantation Internal Fixation Suture Technique for Inframammary Fold Reconstruction in Implant-Based Breast Augmentation: A Retrospective Cohort Study
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- 第一作者: Gao S
- 单位: Department of Plastic Surgery, The Affiliated Friendship Plastic Surgery Hospital of Nanjing Medical University, No.146, Han-zhong Road, Nanjing, 210029, Jiangsu, China
- PMID: 42820993 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06282-4
- 事实: 53例下皱襞入路用改良内固定缝法，3例假体下移<5mm，无翻修，平均随访12个月。
- 点评: 技术可行，但“满意度100%”出自单术者回顾、无对照；假体位置得看更长期。
- English: In 53 IMF-approach augmentations using a modified internal fixation suture, 3 implants displaced less than 5 mm inferiorly, none needed revision, and mean follow-up was 12 months. The technique is feasible for fold support, but a single-surgeon retrospective series claiming 100% satisfaction cannot establish superiority over standard closure.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-14-pmid-42820993

## 2026-11-13

### Prospective Assessment of Nasal Airway Function After Primary Open Rhinoplasty
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- 第一作者: Koçdemir Erul N
- 单位: Department of Otorhinolaryngology-Head and Neck Surgery, Beypazarı State Hospital, Ankara, Turkey
- PMID: 43007373 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06413-x
- 事实: 32例美容开鼻鼻整形3个月，PNIF 76.9→86.2，NOSE 23.4→14.3，鼻塞感略差。
- 点评: 功能没变差、反而改善；但客观气流与患者感受互不相关，别拿PNIF替病人说话。
- English: In 32 aesthetic-only open rhinoplasties, PNIF rose from 76.9 to 86.2 L/min and NOSE fell from 23.4 to 14.3 at 3 months, though the nasal-fullness item worsened slightly. Airway function was preserved and even improved, but objective airflow and patient-reported scores did not correlate, so neither can stand in for the other.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-13-pmid-43007373

### A Single Rib Integrated Scaffold for Semiopen Revision Rhinoplasty After Nasolabial Flap
- 期刊: Journal of Craniofacial Surgery
- 第一作者: Wu S
- 单位: Department of Rhinoplasty and Nasal Reconstruction, Plastic Surgery Hospital, Chinese Academy of Medical Sciences and Peking Union Medical College, Beijing, China
- PMID: 43001659 | DOI: 10.1097/SCS.0000000000011731
- 事实: 20例鼻唇沟皮瓣后翻修，四段肋软骨支架经双侧鼻翼缘送入，12个月ROE 48.5→88.2。
- 点评: 瘢痕挛缩做不了常规开放式时，这条路走得通；单术者20例，只算可行，不算优选。
- English: In 20 revision cases after nasolabial flap, a four-component rib scaffold delivered through bilateral alar rim incisions raised ROE from 48.5 to 88.2 at 12 months with no infection or extrusion. A workable route when scar contracture makes the standard open approach hazardous, but this single-surgeon series of 20 establishes feasibility, not superiority.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-13-pmid-43001659

### Prevention of Secondary Deformities at the Donor Site After Cartilage Transplantation
- 期刊: Journal of Craniofacial Surgery
- 第一作者: Shi J
- 单位: Department of Plastic Surgery, Shenzhen New Frontier United Family Hospital, Shenzhen, Guangdong Province
- PMID: 42980382 | DOI: 10.1097/SCS.0000000000011647
- 事实: 92例耳软骨取材随访6–18个月：45例无畸形、41例轻度、6例明显未修、0例重度。
- 点评: 供区畸形能压到轻中度，但“轻度”占四成多；别跟病人保证耳朵外形一点不变。
- English: Among 92 auricular cartilage harvests followed 6 to 18 months, 45 ears had no deformity, 41 mild deformity, 6 noticeable but unrevised, and none severe. Modified incision and harvest sites keep donor-site deformity mild at worst, but with 45% mild contour change, promise patients nothing better than that.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-13-pmid-42980382

### Postoperative nausea and vomiting after facelift surgery despite routine dual antiemetic prophylaxis
- 期刊: Research Square (preprint)
- 第一作者: 
- 单位: 
- PMID:  | DOI: 10.21203/rs.3.rs-11330171/v1
- 事实: 220例拉皮，96%用了地塞米松+昂丹司琼，仍62.3%发生恶心呕吐，49%呕吐，住院多9小时。
- 点评: 拉皮加眼睑、手术时间长，PONV风险明显升高；Apfel评分在这里不灵，双药预防不够。
- English: In 220 facelifts with 96% receiving dexamethasone plus ondansetron, PONV still occurred in 62.3%, vomiting in 49%, and hospital stay was 9 hours longer. Concurrent blepharoplasty (OR 5.67) and longer operative time drove PONV while the Apfel score failed to predict it, so dual prophylaxis is not enough in combined long cases.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-13-doi-10.21203-rs.3.rs-11330171

### The Transumbilical Breast Augmentation: Safety and Satisfaction in a Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of 13,210 Breasts
- 期刊: Aesthetic Plastic Surgery
- 第一作者: Gonçalves FGA
- 单位: School of Medicine, Universidade de São Paulo, Sao Paulo, SP, Brazil
- PMID: 42993310 | DOI: 10.1007/s00266-026-06362-5
- 事实: 17项研究、6605人：经脐隆胸血肿0.2%、包膜挛缩1.7%、再干预2.3%，手术约60分钟。
- 点评: 数字漂亮，但几乎全是单臂回顾、随访短，只能证明“能做”，不能证明优于腋下或乳晕。
- English: Across 17 studies and 6,605 patients, transumbilical augmentation showed pooled hematoma 0.2%, capsular contracture 1.7%, and reintervention 2.3%, with a median 60-minute operative time. The low complication rates come almost entirely from retrospective single-arm series with short follow-up, so they support feasibility, not equivalence to axillary or periareolar access.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-13-pmid-42993310

### Five-Year Clinical Performance and Patient-Reported Outcomes of Mentor MemoryGel and MemoryShape Breast Implants (GLOW Study)
- 期刊: Aesthetic Surgery Journal
- 第一作者: Alderman A
- 单位: North Atlanta Plastic Surgery, Alpharetta, GA
- PMID: 42987925 | DOI: 10.1093/asj/sjag234
- 事实: 5年挛缩率：解剖型0.31%、Xtra 1.42%、圆形5.16%；再手术3–5.5%。
- 点评: 0.31%不能读成解剖型更安全，研究没做头对头；但“五年约二十分之一再手术”可以拿去谈话。
- English: At 5 years in primary augmentation, Baker III/IV contracture was 0.31% with MemoryShape, 1.42% with MemoryGel Xtra, and 5.16% with MemoryGel; reoperation for implant-related reasons was 2.9% to 5.5%. The study was not powered for device comparison, so the anatomical implant's 0.31% is not evidence of superiority; the 5-year reoperation rate near 1 in 20 is the number worth quoting.
- Permalink: https://wangmd-cn.com/#2026-11-13-pmid-42987925
